### How to obtain this yourself

| Tool | Command | What you’ll see |
|------|---------|-----------------|
| `dig` | `dig +nocmd site.info ANY +multiline +noall +answer` | A concise list of all record types (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, etc.) |
| `nslookup` | `nslookup -type=any site.info` | Similar to `dig`, but formatted differently |
| Web UI | e.g., https://dnschecker.org/ | Interactive lookup with visual representation |

If you run one of those commands on your own machine, replace the placeholder values above with the actual results you receive.
